It also specifies that version tags are prefixed with "v", which is a common tagging convention.

This file does not contain executable code or perform any system operations. It is purely declarative and used only to inform nvchecker how to detect new versions of the software. The git source points to a legitimate-looking GitHub repository that matches the project name, and there are no signs of obfuscation, network exfiltration, or remote code execution. The content aligns with standard AUR packaging practices for version tracking.

No dangerous commands, suspicious URLs, or malicious patterns are present. The file poses no security risk on its own and is consistent with normal, safe AUR package maintenance workflows.

No obfuscated commands, suspicious downloads, or unauthorized system modifications are present. Therefore, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction is safe.
</details>
